blinding: NONE; model and stage labels visible
panel: All 24 frozen requests, both models, RAW and POST: 96 observations
views: Shared-scale opposite surface views and front/side finite sections at the input C bounding-box center
task: Diverse Bench completion containing the supplied coherent planar C. The source parent's exact style is not the required answer. C may be a top, underside, side board or other plausible part; do not require every input to be used as a seat.

fields.recognizable_complete_bench: YES / NO / UNCERTAIN: recognizable bench with a coherent main body/support arrangement; no source-style matching
fields.C_plausibly_used: YES / NO / UNCERTAIN: C plausibly participates in the visible completion, versus remaining detached, superseded by an obvious conflicting layer, or structurally unexplained. This is not a topological certification.
fields.visible_detached_fragments: YES / NO / UNCERTAIN: actual isolated or visibly floating pieces in the inspected views; section cut traces alone do not prove detached faces
fields.visible_holes_or_tears: YES / NO / UNCERTAIN: obvious unintended-looking gaps or ruptures, distinguishing plausible open construction where possible
fields.visible_fold_or_overlap: YES / NO / UNCERTAIN: visually evident folded, intersecting or layered sheets; objective finite-triangle scores remain separate
fields.notes: Concrete image observations and ambiguity, including differences between surface views and sections

limits: These are nonblind AI image observations, not human ratings or ground truth. A section appearance alone does not certify connectivity or finite-triangle collision. Preserve uncertain cases. Do not turn graph reachability or C coordinate preservation into automatic visual success. No post-hoc sample exclusion or checkpoint choice.
